messages:
carla: Heads-up — preparing a v2.4.1 version bump and cut tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Will open the PR in ~30m. Need quick confirmation on branch pin, changelog fragment, and a CI sweep. @eng-releases FYI.

ben: I can run a focused pipeline sweep after the PR lands. Which tests should I watch for flakiness? :eyes:

carla: PR description will include a tiny checklist: bump version, add changelog fragment, verify windows build, validate canary model. Early flakes we've seen: storage/* integration timeouts and decoder-regression intermittents — I'll attach repro links in the PR.

alice: I'll pick up changelog review and start triaging flakes. If test_queue_overload keeps failing, suggest marking flaky for this cut and backfilling a proper fix later.

ci-bot: pipeline: Started targeted sweep for branch release/2.4.x — 78 jobs queued (approx ETA 6m). Logs will stream to CI console.

dave: Heads-up — there's a large merge on main about to land that could trigger conflicts. Can we hold merges to main from 9:30–10:15 PT to avoid surprise churn? Recommend a short merge freeze.

carla: +1 on merge freeze. I'll open a merge-cordon and put the merge queue on hold. Also plan to reduce heavy job concurrency from 4 -> 2 during the sweep to lower flakiness.

erin: Quick ask from infra: we're planning an autoscaler tweak at 9:30 PT — can we pause that until the sweep completes? It could change runner capacity and skew results.

devops-bot: calendar: Release window created — 2026-03-18 17:00Z (corresponds to 10:00 PT). Invite sent to release-captain, eng leads, infra.

ben: I'll kick off re-runs with increased retries and collect full traces to s3://redwood-ci/logs/2415550000-flake. Will post links when done.

alice: If we need a hotfix, prefer doing a patch branch off release/2.4.x (release/2.4.1-hotfix) instead of touching main.

carla: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7890 — includes changelog fragment and linked repros. Tagging @release-captain for awareness. Please avoid force-pushes to release/* — we'll merge squash.

releasebot: artifact: Release candidate built: rc://2.4.1-2415550000 (sha: abc123).

ben: Re-runs complete. Two jobs still flakey: decoder-regression (failed 2x) and storage-timeout (failed 3x). Full logs uploaded to S3. Assigning to @erin for infra check.

erin: Investigating storage runner mount flags and network egress. Found a missing mount option on a subset of runners — patching now. ETA ~20m.

alice: Changelog fragment approved. PR link above.

ci-bot: Re-run results in CI: all functional jobs green except a transient lint error in job-frontend (non-blocking). No critical failures.

carla: Great — aim to have final CI pass by 09:45 PT so we can merge by 10:00. If any blocking flakes persist, @alice please paste failing job links here.

dave: I'll hold merges on main and coordinate with @platform to pause large merges until cutoff.

ben: If infra can't stabilize decoder-regression in 20m, proposal: skip decoder-regression for this cut (mark flaky) and open a follow-up with test owner + scoreboard.

alice: I agree with skipping only if failing >3 times on re-runs and we've captured repros. Otherwise block.

erin: Storage mount fix applied. Re-running the affected jobs now.

ci-bot: Final runs finished: all jobs green. job-frontend had an intermittent lint fail but rerun cleared it.

carla: Green across the board — merging in 5. Thanks all. Posting final cutoff and release note after merge. :tada:

alice: Nice work everyone :party_parrot:
